sanskrit_verse:
पाशकद्यूतदूतार्थप्रतिरूपकसाहसैः ।
व्याजेनोपार्जितं यच् च तत् कृष्णं समुदाहृतम् ॥
transliteration: pāśakadyūtadūtārthapratirūpakasāhasaiḥ | vyājenopārjitaṃ yac ca tat kṛṣṇaṃ samudāhṛtam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: That which is acquired through gambling, messenger services, imitation, pretense, or usury—such wealth is declared as blackened and condemned.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: Wealth obtained through deceitful or manipulative means lacks dharmic legitimacy.
Causation: The method of acquisition determines the energetic quality of the gain.
Capacity-based responsibility: One who knowingly engages in deceptive acquisition bears full capacity-responsibility for realigning that distortion.
Restoration logic: Misaligned gains must be returned or transmuted to restore cosmic-economic balance.
Consciousness alignment: Only wealth earned through integrity aligns individual consciousness with universal abundance.
executable_legal_axioms: IF wealth is acquired via deception OR usury OR impersonation THEN it SHALL be classified as kṛṣṇa (blackened).
IF classified as kṛṣṇa THEN the holder MUST initiate restitution within seven days OR face automatic asset transfer to public welfare fund.
IF intent to deceive is proven THEN the actor MUST undergo a consciousness-realignment protocol before reintegration.
IF wealth is traced to kṛṣṇa source THEN all derivative transactions SHALL be reviewed for energetic contamination.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any evidence of acquisition through deceit, usury, or impersonation triggers immediate classification of assets as kṛṣṇa. The threshold of responsibility is based on pramāṇa (valid knowledge) of intent and action. Authority lies in restoring energetic purity, not imposing punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that deceptive acquisition distorts dharma-sattva. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that such actions lead to systemic imbalance. Proportional responsibility requires full restitution without punitive overlay. Reality remains non-punitive as the focus is on energetic correction and consciousness restoration.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: The individual must publicly declare the misaligned acquisition and surrender it voluntarily.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: The actor undertakes guided sādhanā to realign consciousness and prevent recurrence.
Capacity Restoration: Participation in community service equal to the value of misaligned gain restores energetic balance.
Integrity Reintegration: After completion of protocols, the individual is formally welcomed back into economic participation.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law. This ruling restores Dharma. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
